1:
SELECT DISTINCT
    "es"."name",
    "es"."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" AS "es"
WHERE "es"."capacity" >= 200
  AND (
      LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
      OR LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%conference%'
  );
3:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE r."food_service" ILIKE '%restaurant%'
  AND r."cuisine" ILIKE '%italian%'

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE r."food_service" ILIKE '%cafe%'
  AND r."cuisine" ILIKE '%italian%'
4:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."address", r."food_service", r."cuisine"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%'
   OR (LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%' AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%')
ORDER BY r."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
10:
SELECT "r"."name"
FROM "room" AS "r"
WHERE LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%lobby%'
   OR LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%lobbies%'
   OR (LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%terrace%' AND "r"."size" = 500);
11:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name"
FROM "room" r
WHERE r."size" = 500
  AND (
    LOWER(r."name") LIKE '%lobby%'
    OR LOWER(r."name") LIKE '%lobbies%'
    OR LOWER(r."name") LIKE '%terrace%'
  )
ORDER BY r."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
12:
SELECT rs."name"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."type" LIKE '%spa%'
  AND rs."type" LIKE '%day%'

UNION ALL


SELECT rs."name"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."type" LIKE '%wellness%'
  AND rs."type" LIKE '%retreat%'
  AND rs."price" = 150.0;
13:
SELECT DISTINCT
    rs."name",
    rs."type"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."price" = 150.0
  AND (
        LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%day spa%'
     OR LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%wellness retreat%'
      )
ORDER BY rs."type" ASC NULLS FIRST, rs."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
14:
SELECT DISTINCT
    rs."name",
    rs."type",
    rs."price"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."price" = 150.0
  AND (
      LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%spa%'
      OR LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%wellness%'
      OR LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%retreat%'
  )
ORDER BY rs."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
15:
SELECT DISTINCT
    "es"."name",
    "es"."event_space",
    "es"."capacity"
FROM "eventspaces" AS "es"
WHERE LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
   OR (LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%conference%' AND "es"."capacity" = 200)
ORDER BY "es"."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
24:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c."name",
    c."vacation_option"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."activities" LIKE '%dance%'
  AND (
      c."vacation_option" LIKE '%cruise%'
      OR c."vacation_option" LIKE '%resort%'
  )
ORDER BY c."vacation_option" ASC NULLS FIRST, c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
25:
SELECT c."name", c."email", c."phonenumber"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."vacation_option" LIKE '%cruise%'

UNION


SELECT c."name", c."email", c."phonenumber"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."vacation_option" LIKE '%resort%'
  AND c."activities" LIKE '%dance%';
41:
SELECT h.name AS hotel_name
FROM hotel h
JOIN city c ON c.id = h.city_id
JOIN roomtype rt ON rt.hotel_id = h.id
JOIN featureinroom fr ON fr.roomtype_id = rt.id
JOIN leisurefeature lf ON lf.id = fr.leisurefeature_id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf.feature LIKE '%swimming%'
GROUP BY h.name

UNION


SELECT h.name AS hotel_name
FROM hotel h
JOIN city c ON c.id = h.city_id
JOIN roomtype rt ON rt.hotel_id = h.id
JOIN featureinroom fr ON fr.roomtype_id = rt.id
JOIN leisurefeature lf ON lf.id = fr.leisurefeature_id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf.feature LIKE '%hot tub%'
GROUP BY h.name

JOIN roomtype rt ON rt.hotel_id = h.id

43:
SELECT DISTINCT h."name"
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND (lf."feature" ILIKE '%pool%' OR lf."feature" ILIKE '%hot tub%')
ORDER BY h."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
44:
SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%guest%'
   OR LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air%condition%'
   OR LOWER(s."description") LIKE '%air%condition%'
ORDER BY g."fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST;
45:
SELECT DISTINCT
    g."fullname",
    r."typeofroom"
FROM "bookings" b
JOIN "guests" g ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air-condition%'
  AND (
        LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%'
     OR LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%room%'
      )
ORDER BY g."fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."typeofroom" ASC NULLS FIRST;

163:
SELECT c."channel_value"
FROM "channels" c
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" crc ON crc."channel_id" = c."channel_id"
GROUP BY c."channel_id", c."channel_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT crc."representative_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "customer_service_representatives"
);
164:
SELECT
    csr."full_name",
    ch."channel_value"
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" csrch
    ON csrch."representative_id" = csr."id"
JOIN "channels" ch
    ON ch."channel_id" = csrch."channel_id"
ORDER BY csr."full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, ch."channel_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
168:
SELECT
    cc."company_name",
    br."role_value"
FROM "construction_companies" cc
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" ccbr
    ON ccbr."construction_company_id" = cc."id"
JOIN "building_roles" br
    ON br."role_id" = ccbr."building_role_id"
ORDER BY cc."company_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
171:
SELECT br."role_value"
FROM "building_roles" br
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" ccbr
  ON ccbr."building_role_id" = br."role_id"
GROUP BY br."role_id", br."role_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ccbr."construction_company_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "construction_companies"
)
ORDER BY br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
172:
SELECT
    cc."company_name",
    br."role_value"
FROM "construction_companies" cc
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" ccbr
    ON ccbr."construction_company_id" = cc."id"
JOIN "building_roles" br
    ON br."role_id" = ccbr."building_role_id"
ORDER BY cc."company_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
173:

    csr."full_name",
    ch."channel_value"
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr

272:
SELECT
    j."title" AS vacancy,
    d."degree_level" AS degree_level,
    d."certification" AS certification
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "degrees" d ON d."job_post" = j."title"
ORDER BY j."title" ASC NULLS FIRST, d."degree_level" ASC NULLS FIRST, d."certification" ASC NULLS FIRST;

288:

    d."certification"

290:

    j."title" AS job_title,
    d."degree_level" AS degree_level
FROM "jobs" j

312:
SELECT DISTINCT sc."full_name"
FROM "sous_chef" sc
JOIN "restaurant" r ON r."sous_chef_id" = sc."sous_id"
JOIN "orders" o ON o."restaurant_id" = r."restaurant_id"
JOIN "order_details" od ON od."order_id" = o."order_id"
JOIN "menu_items" mi ON mi."menu_item_id" = od."menu_item_id"
WHERE mi."item_name" ILIKE '%pizza%'
322:
SELECT "full_name"
FROM (
    SELECT "full_name" FROM "executive_chef"
    UNION
    SELECT "full_name" FROM "sous_chef"
) AS "chefs"
ORDER BY "full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
331:
